cases.name: Randee Leeann Rios
cases.about: Her Go Fund Me said, "Randee was a joyful and kind friend and sister to all, with a bright future. She was one of the most uplifting individuals we had the pleasure of knowing."
cases.narrative:
She died from multiple blunt force trauma and puncture wounds. Police located located an axe and bolt cutters covered in blood in the apartment. 

An associate medical examiner said that she had “at least eleven sharp-force wounds” and had suffered “fifteen strikes to the head”.

The medical examiner said she had severe wounds from trying to protect herself and that all of her injuries were inflicted while she was still alive.
